{{Template:Baseplate_infobox|image=File:PaperDimension.png|previous_baseplate=[[Bonus Baseplate]]|next_baseplate=N/A}}
The '''Paper Dimension''', commonly known as terriac's Pocket Dimension, is a [[location]] hidden within the [[Bonus Baseplate]]. As the name might suggest, it is a landscape themed around the Fundamental Paper Education universe. Its main purpose is to host terriac's house, along with some of the staff team's original characters.
== Features ==
=== Cube Teleporter ===
[[File:CubeTeleporter.png|200px|thumb|right]] :''Main article: [[Cube Teleporter]]'' The '''Cube Teleporter''' is a feature unlocked by multiple upgrades. It allows the player to teleport to different zones of the game.
=== Flying notes ===
[[File:Flying_notes.png|200px|thumb|right]] The '''Flying notes''' are a basic feature of terriac's house. These notes can be touched, in which case they will start spinning in the air. This feature references {{Upgrade|Credits|#1B (Flying notes)}} on the {{Baseplate|Main}}
=== Seesaw ===
[[File:Seesaw_feature.png|200px|thumb|right]] The '''Seesaw''' is a basic feature of terriac's house. This seesaw is interactive, you can sit on it to tip it towards either side. It is also made out of plastic.
=== Tire Swing ===
[[File:Tire_Swing.png|200px|thumb|right]] The '''Tire Swing''' is a basic feature of terriac's house. This tire swing can be sat on, which allows you to swing around in it.
=== Slide ===
[[File:Slide.png|200px|thumb|right]] The '''Slide''' is a basic feature of terriac's house. At the top of this slide is a trip part that allows you to slide down and plummet into the lake.
== Characters ==
=== terriac ===
[[File:Terriac.png|200px|thumb|right]] '''terriac''' is the owner of the Paper Dimension and his house. He answers questions related to the Paper Dimension. He is seen pondering while lying against his bed.
==== Character Trivia ==== * terriac is canonically an artist and a programmer. :* He is both the canonical and actual artist behind the painting seen in his house. :* He is a main scripter behind the development of the game. * terriac claims to have created the Paper Dimension. :* There is no proof to back this up, nor is there any way to disprove it. * terriac does not like to interact with the Main Dimension, and treats the Paper Dimension as his home. * terriac is biromantic, along with Connor.<ref name="biro">As seen in [https://discord.com/channels/1524152170470051870/1524159379195170926/1536394322851926119 this message] from terriac.</ref>
=== Connor ===
[[File:Connor.png|200px|thumb|right]] '''Connor''' is an original character made by terriac. He resides outside of terriac's house. He is a personified metal sign that accessorizes with a long orange and black striped scarf, whose design resembles caution tape. He does not have any dialogue.
Connor initially appears camouflaged as a warning sign. The only interaction the player can have with Connor is to approach him, at which point he will reveal his face and start looking at the player. Walking away from Connor will cause him to revert to his camouflaged state.
==== Character Trivia ==== * Connor also appears as a Main Menu secret 1 out of 4 times. :* He appears on a mountain in the background, and is also significantly larger for the sake of visibility. :* In this state, he does not look at the player, but instead looks around the landscape at random. * Connor interacts with the world through telekinesis. He can lift objects using the equivalent force of a human limb. :* If an object is attached to his body (such as his scarf), he treats the object as his limb, and can generate additional force using it. :* Connor can also use this power on other elements, such as the air, in order to create things such as his voice. * terriac only claimed Connor as his own character ''after'' his creation. :* He was previously property of '''Kaaatie/A3DGhost''', who has since dissociated from all of her characters. :* An unofficial wiki page for Connor in his original universe can be found [https://fundamental-paper-education.fandom.com/wiki/Connor here]. * When asking terriac about Connor, you are also given to choice to ask about other characters, who are supposedly absent. :* This is a reference directed to those who know about it, however it is not relevant to any lore.<ref>As seen in [https://discord.com/channels/1524152170470051870/1533690211664400504/1539994240791089312 this message] from terriac.</ref> * Connor previously had an enraged form, which was designed by [https://x.com/tunafied_ @tunafied_ (X/Twitter)].<ref>As seen in [https://discord.com/channels/1378763095656108133/1384152285218607114/1520999763334533151 this leak].</ref> :* She was originally commissioned to make a Voidbound Connor concept. However, she does not have any knowledge as to who Connor is.<ref>The original commission can be found [https://x.com/tunafied_/status/2061545255921746305 here].</ref> :* It was scrapped along with UNREALITY.<ref>As seen in [https://discord.com/channels/1378763095656108133/1493874192972644453/1532785602976678091 this announcement].</ref> * Connor is biromantic, along with terriac.<ref name="biro"/>
=== Arayde ===
[[File:Arayde.png|200px|thumb|right]] '''Arayde''' is an original character made by Raspbelvet. He occupies the school-like space called NCoH (Numerical Centre of Harmony) in terriac's house. According to terriac, the reasoning for this is that someone rented out the lower floor of his house to make a school out of it. (Needs info.)
=== Stellaria ===
[[File:Stellaria.png|200px|thumb|right]] '''Stellaria''' is an original character made by Sandie. She accessorises with a leotard. (Definitely needs info.) <!-->I found a few notes relating to Stellaria but I have no idea how to interpret them. Please contact me for them<-->
== Trivia == * The ''Numerical Centre of Harmony'' that Arayde occupies is a reference to [https://www.roblox.com/games/9237964584/Noxs-Citadels-of-Hell Nox's Citadels of Hell], which both have the same acronym for. Raspbelvet, the creator of [[Arayde]], is one of the contributors for the mentioned game, being best known for their works on Citadel of Hopes and Dreams in-game under the username l_urne.
== References == <references/> [[Category:Locations]]

<small>not to be confused with [[Badges]], the collectable built in to Roblox</small>

Achievements are a series of collectables that are obtained by achieving something, whether that be obtaining a certain amount of currency, preforming resets, completing challenges, or solving puzzles.
As of v1.0, there are 10 achievements in the game. 6 of which are Leaderboard Achievements, 3 of which are Progression Achievements, and the last one being an Extra Achievement.
Obtaining achievements also rewards AR.
Leaderboard Achievements give 1 AR per tier, up to +7.
Every Achievement also has its own [[Leaderboard]]

Achievements are a series of collectables that are obtained by achieving something, whether that be obtaining a certain amount of currency, preforming resets, completing challenges, or solving puzzles.
As of v1.0, there are 10 achievements in the game, 6 of which are Leaderboard Achievements, 3 of which are Progression Achievements, and the last one being an Extra Achievement.
Obtaining achievements also rewards AR.
Leaderboard Achievements give 1 AR per tier, up to +7.
Most Achievement has its own [[Leaderboard]]

The Trampoline bounces from a [[Baseplate]] to another [[Baseplate]] that it's pointing towards. There are 2 trampolines in the game, a normal orange one going from the [[Main baseplate]] to the [[Bonus baseplate]] and a yellow one with a star on it going from the [[Bonus baseplate]] to the [[Main baseplate]].
[[Category:Features]]

The Trampoline acts as a mean of travel that bounces the player from a [[Baseplate]] to another [[Baseplate]] that it's pointing towards.
There are 2 trampolines in the game, a normal orange one going from the [[Main Baseplate]] to the [[Bonus Baseplate]] and a yellow one with a star on it going from the [[Bonus Baseplate]] to the [[Main Baseplate]]. == Normal Trampoline == [[File:Trampoline2.png|200px|thumb|right]] This trampoline is located on the [[Main Baseplate]]. It has an orange outline. == Star Trampoline == [[File:Trampoline.png|200px|thumb|right]] This trampoline is located on the [[Bonus Baseplate]]. It has a yellow outline with a yellow star on the jump mat. [[Category:Feature]]

The Pyramid is a feature unlocked upon purchasing #PYR (CHALLENGERS) on the [[Prestige Baseplate]]. The Pyramid is used to activate [[Pyramid|Challenges]] with the screen on the front. == Challenges == ''"The immense struggles you've faced will eventually make the pain sweet." - ASAP'' As of v1.0, there are 3 challenges in the game, those being; Credit Deduction, Enviromentalism, Homefinder. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=10%;" | Title ! style="width=10%;" | Cap ! style="width=20%;" | Debuff ! style="width=10%;" | Goal ! style="width=20%;" | Buff ! style="width=40%;" | Description |- | Credit Deduction || 5 || || Prestige || || A small challenge for the overly dedicated.
Hello! This might be your first challenge, so I'll give you the
rundown!
To beat the challenge, you have to reach a specified goal with a
specified debuff. After reaching the goal, the challenge's level
will increase and you'll gain a specified buff. Good luck!
''Yellow wavelength is disabled''
Income Tax? |- | Enviromentalism || 1 || [CREDITS] and
[RESEARCH] upgrades
turn green || Prestige || +250/s and
×1.25 Credits
gain || Ever wondered how green things can get?
This challenge turns most [CREDITS] and [RESEARCH] upgrades
green, which forces them to be addition based only.
''Some upgrade tags like [CREDITS+] [AUTOMATION] and [BONUS]
remain unaffected
Yellow Wavelength is disabled |- | Homefinder || 1 || Sandstorm &
more || Prestige for
500 ₽ || Nothing ... but
bragging rights
for now || Are you ready to face the sandstorm? ''(Best experienced solo)''
Welcome! this is the last and hardest challenge of Prestige,
which is also required to progress further.
Once you purchase upgrade #1, a deadly sandstorm will appear.
This sandstorm comes with many hurdles, including:
• Strong winds (constrained movement, reduced visibility)
• Flying projectiles that damage you
• ^0.925 & Diminishing Credits gain overtime
• Cube Clicks per click are divided by 5
• The Core is disabled
• Automation is disabled
You will have four and a half minutes to complete the challenge;
you must reach the goal as soon as possible. Best of luck, you're
going to need it!
''By the way, you have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting. If
all participants leave or get kicked out, your run is over.'' [[Category:Features]]

''By the way, you have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting. If
all participants leave or get kicked out, your run is over.'' |} == Trivia == * Before release, ''Very Optional Homefinder'' was originally called ''Homefinder'', and the challenge was going to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. The challenge was also intended to have a much harder requirement, being prestiging for {{Prestige|1000}} instead of the current {{Prestige|500}}. As development progressed, the challenge had its requirement reduced along the way. After a few weeks of the game's official release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. * While the game was in development, ''Very Optional Homefinder's'' soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). tasked with growing the stud as high
as possible within 60 seconds.
Upon starting this challenge,
you will be sent to the {{Baseplate|Bonus}}. ''
You have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting.
'' |} == Trivia == * The text "Income Tax?" as seen in the description of ''Credit Deduction'' is a homage to [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=4634f5486889014b8a654e1417d7bd1b&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1785685145396 Not JJT Upgrade Tree], a previous game made by a_sapian (Upgradex's creator) under the group [https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32673841 Bauspicious Games]. In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as ''Credit Deduction'', applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * While in development, ''Homefinder'' was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade #11P (ZEAL) can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The goal being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Required for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as ''Credit Deduction'', applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * While in development, ''Homefinder'' was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade #11P (ZEAL) can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The goal being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Required for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

{{Upgrade|#11β (LOCK IN)|Beta}}, adding +5% of the challenge's level to the mastery's formula, reaching a maximum of +100% at the upgrade's cap. == Trivia == * The text "Income Tax?" as seen in the description of ''Credit Deduction'' is a homage to [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=4634f5486889014b8a654e1417d7bd1b&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1785685145396 Not JJT Upgrade Tree], a previous game made by a_sapian (Upgradex's creator) under the group [https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32673841 Bauspicious Games]. In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as ''Credit Deduction'', applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * While in development, ''Homefinder'' was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade #11P (ZEAL) can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The goal being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Required for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

The Pyramid is a feature unlocked upon purchasing {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR (CHALLENGERS)}} on the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}. The Pyramid is used to activate [[Pyramid|Challenges]] with the screen on the front. == Challenges == ''"The immense struggles you've faced will eventually make the pain sweet." - ASAP'' Challenges are the main mechanic of the Pyramid.

'' |} The buff from {{Upgrade|NJUT|Studs to Space}} can also improve {{Baseplate|Bonus}} progression, mainly by buffing mastery '''{{Color|rgb(182, 253, 192)|05|Black}}''' through upgrade
{{Upgrade|Beta|#11β (LOCK IN)}}, adding +5% of the challenge's level (also known as your highest {{Studs}} grown) to the mastery's formula, reaching a maximum of +100% at the upgrade's cap. == Trivia == * The text "Income Tax?" as seen in the description of ''Credit Deduction'' is a homage to [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=4634f5486889014b8a654e1417d7bd1b&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1785685145396 Not JJT Upgrade Tree], a previous game made by a_sapian (Upgradex's creator) under the group [https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32673841 Bauspicious Games]. In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as ''Credit Deduction'', applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * While in development, ''Homefinder'' was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#11P (ZEAL)}} can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The goal being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Required for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

(displays highest {{Studs}} grown) | 60s Timer | Grow the stud as much as you can | +0.005× {{Beta|Beta|symbol=no}} for every {{Studs}} past 40 | '''How high can you take the stud?'''
This is a timer challenge where you're
tasked with growing the stud as high
as possible within 60 seconds.
Upon starting this challenge,
you will be sent to the {{Baseplate|Bonus}}. ''
You have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting.
'' |} The buff from {{Upgrade|NJUT|Studs to Space}} can also improve {{Baseplate|Bonus}} progression, mainly by buffing mastery '''{{Color|rgb(182, 253, 192)|05|Black}}''' through upgrade
{{Upgrade|Beta|#11β (LOCK IN)}}, adding +5% of the challenge's level (also known as your highest {{Studs}} grown) to the mastery's formula, reaching a maximum of +100% at the upgrade's cap. == Trivia == * The text "Income Tax?" as seen in the description of ''Credit Deduction'' is a homage to [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=4634f5486889014b8a654e1417d7bd1b&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1785685145396 Not JJT Upgrade Tree], a previous game made by a_sapian (Upgradex's creator, also known as Sapian) under the group [https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32673841 Bauspicious Games]. In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as ''Credit Deduction'', applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * Both ''Homefinder'' and ''Cyclic Dependency'' were mostly made by TerribleAtCreating (also known as [[Paper Dimension|terriac]]), where ''Homefinder'' was made only by himself, while ''Cyclic Dependency'' had other contributions. * While in development, ''Homefinder'' was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#11P (ZEAL)}} can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The goal being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Required for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The video for ''Homefinder'' 's verification can be found [https://youtu.be/nmqBj6mifeU?t=100 here]. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

[[File:Pyramid.png|300px|class=pageimage|link=|alt=]] [[File:Pyramid.png|500px|thumb|center|The Pyramid]]
The Pyramid is a feature unlocked upon purchasing {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR (CHALLENGERS)}} on the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}. The Pyramid is used to activate [[Pyramid|Challenges]] with the screen on the front. == Challenges == ''"The immense struggles you've faced will eventually make the pain sweet."'' Challenges are the main mechanic of the Pyramid.
They are "scenarios" that can be activated, performing a reset and applying a debuff to gameplay. The player must reach the goal while in the challenge. Once reaching the goal, the challenge is completed and the debuff is removed. In return, the player gains a buff to currencies that are listed. ---- Prestige Challenges= [[File:Prestigechallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Prestige Challenges tab]] {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked by default when purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR}}.
As of v1.1, there are 3 {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} in the game, those being: Credit Deduction, Environmentalism and Homefinder. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width:5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width:15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width:20%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width:35%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | Credit Deduction | 9 | {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}}(1-0.1*lvl) | {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} | ×2lvl {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} | '''A small challenge for the overly dedicated.'''
Hello! This might be your first challenge, so I'll give you the
rundown!
To beat the challenge, you have to reach a specified goal with a
specified debuff. After reaching the goal, the challenge's level
will increase and you'll gain a specified buff. Good luck!
{{Wavelength|yellow|Yellow Wavelength}} is disabled
Income Tax? |- | Environmentalism | 1 | {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-All}}
and
{{Tag|Upgrade|Research-All}} upgrades turn green | {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} | +250/s and ×1.25 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain | '''Ever wondered how green things can get?'''
This challenge turns most Credits and Research upgrades green, forcing them to be addition-based only.
''Some upgrade tags like {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Plus-All}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Automation}}, and {{Tag|Upgrade|Bonus}} remain unaffected.
{{Wavelength|yellow|Yellow Wavelength}} is disabled.'' |- | Homefinder | 1 | Sandstorm & more | {{Prestige|Prestige for
1k }} | ×1.25 {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} and {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} gain | '''Are you ready to face the sandstorm?'''
''(Best experienced solo)''
Welcome!
This is the great prestige challenge nicknamed "Homefinder".
This one definitely increases up the ante, so buckle up!
Once you purchase upgrade #1, a deadly sandstorm will appear.
This sandstorm comes with many hurdles, including:
• Strong winds (constrained movement, reduced visibility)
• Flying projectiles that damage you
• ×0 Credits gain that recovers exponentially overtime
• ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain
• The Core is disabled
• Automation is disabled
• Upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#11P (ZEAL)}} is disabled
You will have four and a half minutes to complete the challenge;
you must reach the goal as soon as possible. Best of luck, you're
going to need it!
''By the way, you have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting. If
all participants leave or get kicked out, your run is over.'' |} |-| Ascension Challenges= [[File:Ascensionchallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Ascension Challenges tab]] {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked upon purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR+ (BRAVERY)}}, located on the 2nd layer of the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}.
As of v1.1, there are 2 {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} in the game, those being: Cyclic Dependency and Out of Stock. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width:5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width:15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width:20%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width:35%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | Cyclic Dependency | 3 | (50-10*lvl)s before auto-reset | {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} | ×1.5lvl {{CXP}}
and {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} gain | '''You are part of the cycle.'''
Don't try to break out of it.
In this challenge, you will have a
limited amount of time to gain currency
after buying #1, after which the
{{Baseplate|Main}} will reset itself.
In other words,
the end of each cycle will perform
a {{Data|Research Reset|symbol=no}} with
no currency gain. |- | Out of Stock | 5 | Only (32-4*lvl) unique upgrades
(-2 per Prestige) | {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} | ×1.25lvl {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} gain | '''The economy's taking a hit...'''
In this challenge, you will have a
limited amount of specific upgrades
to work with.
These include:
{{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-All}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Plus-All}},
{{Tag|Upgrade|Research-All}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Prestige-All}} ''
Only non-permanent upgrades apply
Some upgrades will not be auto-unlocked
for challenge fluidity'' |} |-| Bonus Challenges= [[File:Bonuschallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Bonus Challenges tab]] {{Alpha|Bonus Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked upon purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Beta|#10β (Canonical)}} located in the 2nd layer of the {{Baseplate|Bonus}}.
As of v1.1, there is only 1 {{Alpha|Bonus Challenge|symbol=no}} in the game, that being {{Upgrade|NJUT|Studs to Space}}. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width:5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width:15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width:20%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width:35%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | {{Upgrade|NJUT|Studs to Space}} | None
(displays highest {{Studs}} grown) | 60s Timer | Grow the stud as much as you can | +0.005× {{Beta|Beta|symbol=no}} for every {{Studs}} past 40 | '''How high can you take the stud?'''
This is a timer challenge where you're
tasked with growing the stud as high
as possible within 60 seconds.
Upon starting this challenge,
you will be sent to the {{Baseplate|Bonus}}. ''
You have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting.
'' |} The sum of all challenge levels across the {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} and {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} buff {{Alpha|Alpha|symbol=no}} gain through mastery '''{{Color|#b6fdc0|05|Black}}''', increasing gain based off the square of all challenge levels. {{Upgrade|NJUT|Studs to Space}} can also improve {{Alpha|Alpha|symbol=no}} gain, mainly by buffing mastery '''{{Color|#b6fdc0|05|Black}}''' through upgrade
{{Upgrade|Beta|#11β (LOCK IN)}}, adding +5% of the challenge's level (also known as your highest {{Studs}} grown) to the mastery's formula, reaching a maximum of +100% at the upgrade's cap of 20.
 == Related Features == These are features that interact with Challenges and the Pyramid through additional buffs or automation. Autochallenger= :''Main article: [[Autochallenger]] [[File:Autochallenger.png|400px|thumb|center|The Autochallenger]] The Autochallenger is unlocked upon buying upgrade {{Data|#AC+ (autocom = 2)|symbol=no}}. This feature sets your challenge levels to a certain level every {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} based on how much {{CXP}} was passively gained during the {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}}. {{CXP}} gain can be improved through the player's current {{Energy|Energy|symbol=no}} and upgrade {{Data|#AC2 (effic.chg())|symbol=no}}, and a percentage of it can be kept through upgrade {{Data|#AC3 (reset.chg())|symbol=no}}. == Trivia == * The text "Income Tax?" as seen in the description of ''Credit Deduction'' is a homage to [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=4634f5486889014b8a654e1417d7bd1b&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1785685145396 Not JJT Upgrade Tree], a previous game made by a_sapian (Upgradex's creator, also known as Sapian) under the group [https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32673841 Bauspicious Games]. In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as ''Credit Deduction'', applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * Both ''Homefinder'' and ''Cyclic Dependency'' were mostly made by TerribleAtCreating (also known as [[Paper Dimension|terriac]]), where ''Homefinder'' was made only by himself, while ''Cyclic Dependency'' had other contributions. * While in development, ''Homefinder'' was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#11P (ZEAL)}} can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The goal being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Required for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, ''Homefinder'' had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The video for ''Homefinder'' 's verification can be found [https://youtu.be/nmqBj6mifeU?t=100 here]. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The video for ''Homefinder'' 's verification can be found [https://youtu.be/nmqBj6mifeU?t=100 here]. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

[[File:Pyramid.png|300px|class=pageimage|link=|alt=]] [[File:Pyramid.png|500px|thumb|center|The Pyramid]]
The Pyramid is a feature unlocked upon purchasing {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR (CHALLENGERS)}} on the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}. The Pyramid is used to activate [[Pyramid|Challenges]] with the screen on the front. == Challenges == ''"The immense struggles you've faced will eventually make the pain sweet."'' Challenges are the main mechanic of the Pyramid.
They are "scenarios" that can be activated, performing a reset and applying a debuff to gameplay. The player must reach the goal while in the challenge. Once reaching the goal, the challenge is completed and the debuff is removed. In return, the player gains a buff to currencies that are listed. ---- Prestige Challenges= [[File:Prestigechallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Prestige Challenges tab]] {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked by default when purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR}}.
As of v1.1, there are 3 {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} in the game, those being: Credit Deduction, Environmentalism and Homefinder. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width:5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width:15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width:10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width:20%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width:35%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | Credit Deduction | 9 | {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}}(1-0.1*lvl) | {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} | ×2lvl {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} | '''A small challenge for the overly dedicated.'''

specified debuff. After reaching the goal, the challenge's level
will increase and you'll gain a specified buff. Good luck!

''(Best experienced solo)''
Welcome!
This is the great prestige challenge nicknamed "Homefinder".
This one definitely increases up the ante, so buckle up!
Once you purchase upgrade #1, a deadly sandstorm will appear.
This sandstorm comes with many hurdles, including:
• Strong winds (constrained movement, reduced visibility)
• Flying projectiles that damage you
• ×0 Credits gain that recovers exponentially overtime
• ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain
• The Core is disabled
• Automation is disabled
• Upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#11P (ZEAL)}} is disabled

you must reach the goal as soon as possible. Best of luck, you're
going to need it!

all participants leave or get kicked out, your run is over.'' |} |-| Ascension Challenges= [[File:Ascensionchallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Ascension Challenges tab]] {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked upon purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR+ (BRAVERY)}}, located on the 2nd layer of the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}.

{{Upgrade|Beta|#11β (LOCK IN)}}, adding +5% of the challenge's level (also known as your highest {{Studs}} grown) to the mastery's formula, reaching a maximum of +100% at the upgrade's cap of 20. == Related Features == These are features that interact with Challenges and the Pyramid through additional buffs or automation. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the debuff, goal and buff, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. * While the game was in development, ''Homefinder'' 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The video for ''Homefinder'' 's verification can be found [https://youtu.be/nmqBj6mifeU?t=100 here]. * The name ''Homefinder'' is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

the {{Upgrade|Pyramid|Pyramid}} is a feature unlocked upon purchasing {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR (CHALLENGERS)}} on the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}. the {{Upgrade|Pyramid|Pyramid}} is used to activate [[Pyramid|Challenges]] with the UI on it. == Challenges == :''"The immense struggles you've faced will eventually make the pain sweet."'' Challenges are the main mechanic of the {{Upgrade|Pyramid|Pyramid}}.
They are "scenarios" that can be activated, performing a reset and applying a {{Upgrade|Debuff|debuff}} to gameplay. The player must reach the {{Upgrade|Goal|goal}} while in the challenge. Once the {{Upgrade|Goal|goal}} is reached, the challenge is completed and the {{Upgrade|Debuff|debuff}} is removed. In return, the player gains a list of {{Upgrade|Buff|buffs}} that gets better with each challenge levels completed. ---- Prestige Challenges= [[File:Prestigechallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Prestige Challenges tab]] {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked by default when purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|#PYR}}.
As of v1.1, there are 3 {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} in the game, those being: {{Challenge|Credit Deduction}}, {{Challenge|Environmentalism}} and {{Challenge|Homefinder}}. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width=10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width=5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width=15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width=10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width=15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width=40%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | {{Challenge|Credit Deduction}} | 9 | {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}}(1-0.1*lvl) | {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} | {{Upgrade|Orange|×2lvl}} {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} | {{Challenge|Credit Deduction|A small challenge for the overly dedicated.}}
Hello! This might be your first challenge, so I'll give you the
rundown!
To beat the challenge, you have to reach a {{Upgrade|Goal|specified goal}} with a
{{Upgrade|Debuff|specified debuff}}. After reaching the goal, the challenge's level
will increase and you'll gain a {{Upgrade|Buff|specified buff}}. ''Good luck!
{{Wavelength|yellow|Yellow Wavelength}} is disabled
Income Tax?'' |- | {{Challenge|Environmentalism}} | 1 | {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-All}}
and
{{Tag|Upgrade|Research-All}} upgrades turn green | {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} | {{Upgrade|Green|+250/s}} and {{Upgrade|Orange|×1.25}} {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain | {{Challenge|Environmentalism|Ever wondered how green things can get?}}
This challenge turns most {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-True}} and {{Tag|Upgrade|Research-True}} upgrades green, forcing them to be addition-based only.
''Some upgrade tags like {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Plus-All}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Automation}}, and {{Tag|Upgrade|Bonus}} remain unaffected.
{{Wavelength|yellow|Yellow Wavelength}} is disabled.'' |- | {{Challenge|Homefinder}} | 1 | Sandstorm & more | {{Prestige|Prestige for
1k }} | {{Upgrade|Orange|×1.25}} {{Ascension|Ascension }} and {{Prestige|Prestige }} gain | {{Challenge|Homefinder|Are you ready to face the sandstorm?}} ''(Best experienced solo)''
Welcome! This is the great prestige challenge nicknamed "Homefinder".
This one definitely increases up the ante, so buckle up!
Once you purchase upgrade #1, a {{Upgrade|Goal|deadly sandstorm}} will appear. This sandstorm comes with many {{Upgrade|Debuff|hurdles}}, including:
• '''Strong winds''' (constrained movement, reduced visibility)
• '''Flying projectiles''' that damage you
• '''×0 Credits gain''' that recovers exponentially overtime
• '''×0.01 Cube Clicks''' gain
• The Core is '''disabled'''
• Automation is '''disabled'''
• Upgrade #11P (ZEAL) is '''disabled'''
You will have four and a half minutes to complete the challenge; you must reach the goal as soon as possible. Best of luck, you're going to need it!
''By the way, you have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting. If all participants leave or get kicked out, your run is over.'' |} |-| Ascension Challenges= [[File:Ascensionchallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Ascension Challenges tab]] {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked upon purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Prestige|PYR+ (BRAVERY)}}, located on the 2nd layer of the {{Baseplate|Prestige}}.
As of v1.1, there are 2 {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} in the game, those being: {{Challenge|Cyclic Dependency}} and {{Challenge|Out of Stock}}. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width=10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width=5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width=15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width=10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width=15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width=40%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | {{Challenge|Cyclic Dependency}} | 3 | (50-10*lvl)s before auto-reset | {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} | {{Upgrade|Orange|×1.5lvl}} {{CXP}}
and {{Prestige|Prestige|symbol=no}} gain | {{Challenge|Cyclic Dependancy|You are part of the cycle. Don't try to break out of it.}}
In this challenge, you will have a limited amount of time to gain currency after buying '''#1''', after which the {{Baseplate|Main}} will reset itself.
''In other words, the end of each cycle will perform a {{Data|Research Reset|symbol=no}} with no currency gain.'' |- | {{Challenge|Out of Stock}} | 5 | Only (32-4*lvl) unique upgrades
(-2 per Prestige) | {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} | {{Upgrade|Orange|×1.25lvl}} {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} gain | {{Challenge|Out of Stock|The economy's taking a hit...}}
In this challenge, you will have a limited amount of specific upgrades to work with. These include:
{{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-True}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Plus-True}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Research-True}}, {{Tag|Upgrade|Prestige-True}} ''
Only non-permanent upgrades apply
Some upgrades will not be auto-unlocked for challenge fluidity'' |} |-| Bonus Challenges= [[File:Bonuschallenges.png|400px|thumb|center|The Bonus Challenges tab]] {{Alpha|Bonus Challenges|symbol=no}} are unlocked upon purchasing upgrade {{Upgrade|Beta|#10β (Canonical)}} located in the 2nd layer of the {{Baseplate|Bonus}}.
As of v1.1, there is only 1 {{Alpha|Bonus Challenge|symbol=no}} in the game, that being {{Challenge|Studs to Space}}. ---- {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width:70vw;" ! style="width=10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Title ! style="width=5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Cap ! style="width=15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Debuff ! style="width=10%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Goal ! style="width=15%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Buff ! style="width=40%; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | Description |- | {{Challenge|Studs to Space}} | None
(displays highest {{Studs}} grown) | 60s Timer | Grow the stud as much as you can | +0.01× {{Beta|Beta|symbol=no}} for every {{Studs|Stud|symbol=no}} past 40 | {{Challenge|Studs to Space|How high can you take the stud?}}
This is a timer challenge where you're tasked with growing the stud as high as possible within '''60 seconds'''.
Upon starting this challenge, you will be sent to the {{Baseplate|Bonus}}. ''
You have to beat the entire challenge in one sitting.
'' |} The sum of all challenge levels across the {{Prestige|Prestige Challenges|symbol=no}} and {{Ascension|Ascension Challenges|symbol=no}} buff {{Alpha|Alpha|symbol=no}} gain through mastery {{Upgrade|Mastery|05}}, increasing gain based off the square of all challenge levels. {{Challenge|Studs to Space}} can also improve {{Alpha|Alpha|symbol=no}} gain, mainly by buffing mastery {{Upgrade|Mastery|05}} through upgrade
{{Upgrade|Beta|#11β (LOCK IN)}}, adding +5% of the challenge's level (your highest {{Studs}} grown in it) to the mastery's formula, reaching a maximum of +100% at the upgrade's cap of 20. == Related Features == These are features that interact with Challenges and the {{Upgrade|Pyramid|Pyramid}} through additional buffs or automation. ---- Automation= There are features that help automate the process of completing challenges in order to save time throughout the game, notably: === Auto-completion === The auto-completion (or automatic completion) of a challenge is unlocked through upgrade {{Upgrade|Automation plus|AC (autocom = 1)|symbol=no}}, where upon reaching the {{Upgrade|Goal|goal}} of any challenge, it will automatically complete the challenge by performing the corresponding reset. === Autochallenger === :''Main article: [[Autochallenger]] [[File:Autochallenger.png|400px|thumb|center|The Autochallenger]] The Autochallenger is unlocked upon buying upgrade {{Upgrade|Automation plus|#AC+ (autocom = 2)|symbol=no}}. This feature sets your challenge levels to a certain level after an {{Ascension|Ascension reset|symbol=no}} based on how much {{CXP|CXP (Challenge XP)|symbol=no}} was gained during the preivous {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}}. {{CXP}} gain is based on the player's current {{Energy|Energy|symbol=no}} and can be boosted by upgrade {{Upgrade|Automation plus|#AC2 (effic.chg())|symbol=no}}. Additionally, a percentage of it can be kept after an {{Ascension|Ascension reset|symbol=no}} through upgrade {{Upgrade|Automation plus|#AC3 (reset.chg())|symbol=no}}. == History == * While in development, {{Challenge|Homefinder}} was planned to be a bullet hell challenge instead of the sandstorm seen in game. As development progressed, the challenge's original idea had been scrapped, now replaced with the sandstorm, albeit with some changes compared to the current version, that being: :: ^0.925 & Diminishing {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain overtime (instead of ×0 {{Credits|Credits|symbol=no}} gain that recovers exponentially overtime) :: Cube Click per click gain is divided by 5 (instead of ×0.01 Cube Clicks gain) :: Upgrade {{Prestige|#11P (ZEAL)|symbol=no}} can be enabled (instead of always being disabled) :: The {{Upgrade|Goal|goal}} being prestiging for {{Prestige|500}} instead of {{Prestige|1k}} :: Initially being a prerequisite for unlocking the {{Baseplate|Ascension}} and consequently, performing an {{Ascension|Ascension|symbol=no}} reset * After a few weeks of the game's release, {{Challenge|Homefinder}} had it's name changed to ''Very Optional Homefinder'' for the rest of v1.0 and some text was added accordingly after backlash from the community for it's steeper difficulty. These changes have been reverted in v1.1 along with changes to the {{Upgrade|Debuff|debuff}}, {{Upgrade|Goal|goal}} and {{Upgrade|Buff|buff}}, now removing it as a requirement for unlocking the {{Ascension|Ascension Baseplate|symbol=no}}. Its [[badges|badge]] was also archived, deprecated and replaced by a new one. == Trivia == * The text "Income Tax?" as seen in the description of {{Challenge|Credit Deduction}} is a homage to [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=4634f5486889014b8a654e1417d7bd1b&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1785685145396 Not JJT Upgrade Tree], a previous game made by a_sapian (Upgradex's founder, also known as Sapian) under the group [https://www.roblox.com/share/g/32673841 Bauspicious Games]. In the game, a challenge known as "Income Taxed" also has the same gimmick as {{Challenge|Credit Deduction}}, applying an exponent to the first currency's gain and a relatively similar goal and buff to the first currency. * Both {{Challenge|Homefinder}} and {{Challenge|Cyclic Dependency}} were mostly made by TerribleAtCreating (also known as [[Paper Dimension|terriac]]), where {{Challenge|Homefinder}} was made only by himself, while {{Challenge|Cyclic Dependency}} had other contributions. * While the game was in development, {{Challenge|Homefinder}} 's soundtrack was originally Cruiser by MoTER ([https://youtu.be/ODxyUfwS5qc Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/11aEvDB2vWO5iizv85dfJ1 Spotify]). However, the soundtrack was scrapped and replaced with SOLSTICE by KORAII ([https://youtu.be/HMw3yRij_Bs Youtube] and [https://open.spotify.com/track/5rNUocuoh7a89U6KWwGWGH Spotify]) at some point before release. * The video for {{Challenge|Homefinder}}'s verification can be found [https://youtu.be/nmqBj6mifeU?t=100 here]. * The name {{Challenge|Homefinder}} is a reference to Tower of The Homefinder, which can be played in [https://www.roblox.com/share?code=5c6982c0cfa1b9448ead2df1d6bf7819&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1784903897098 The Eternal Abyss], [https://www.roblox.com/games/10283991824 Caleb's Soul Crushing Domain], or in it's own place [https://www.roblox.com/games/118109038031866 here]. A video of the verifier's completion of the tower can also be watched [https://youtube.com/watch?v=OdZNiNn_K2w here]. [[Category:Features]]

To access the settings, hold F at the proximity prompt when you are near the structure. This will open a Gui where you can toggle different settings. The Computer is a feature that lets players play games and is unlocked after purchasing #3RB (Tinkering)
==Arithmetism== Arithmetism is a program that tells players what properties a given natural number has, and gives it a score based on its properties. Note that if a number has a property that is a combination of 2 other properties, the 2 other properties will not show up. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=15%;" | Name ! style="width=65%;" | Definition ! style="width=20%;" | Example |- | Palindromic number | Remains the same when its digits are reversed (also has to be at least 3 digits) | 121 |- | Strobogrammatic number | Remains the same when flipped upside down | 69 |- | Tetradic number | Is both palindromic and strobogrammatic | 101 |- | Two-faced number | Has no matching digits with its reverse | can't find one |- | Constantly ascending | These numbers have constantly ascending digits | 123, 246 |}
==baldi basics v2== baldi basics v2, also known as baldi basics thingy 2 DEMO, is a game where players answer math question with a time limit,starting with 10 seconds and decreasing after every answer. players get 3 lives, if players lose them all players lose. There is a combo system that does nothing as of v1.0. ===Easy=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=25%;" | Type of question ! style="width=75%;" | Objective |- | Simple addition | Add 2 numbers together |- | Simple subtraction | Subtract one number from the other |- | Counting problems | Count the number of items on screen |- | Word problems | Answer the problem based on the passage |} ===Medium=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=25%;" | Type of question ! style="width=75%;" | Objective |- | Perfect square | Figure out whether the number given is a square or not |- | Exponent multiplication | Multiply 2 numbers together with the same base |- | Exponent division | Divide one number by the other with the same base |} ===Hard=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! Players get 3 lives, losing all 3 lives will result in a lost. If the player answer a question incorrectly or fail to answer within the time limit, a live will be lost. There's a combo counter located at the bottom left of the window, which increments for each question answered correctly and reset for every live lost. ==== Easy ==== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=20%;" | Type of question ! style="width=70%;" | Objective ! style="width=10%;" | Time limit |- | Basic operations | Add or subtract 2 numbers. | 10s |- | Counting problems - 1 | Count the number of polygons. | 15s |- | Counting problems - 2 | Count the number of edges of the given shape. | 20s |- | Pattern recognition | Fill in the missing value from the given array. | 15s |- | Word problems - 1 | Answer the problem based on the passage. The problem requires doing '''basic operations'''. | 10s |- | Word problems - 2 | Answer the problem based on the passage. The problem requires doing '''basic operations''' with '''time'''. | 25s |} ==== Medium ==== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=20%;" | Type of question ! style="width=70%;" | Objective ! style="width=10%;" | Time limit |- | Perfect square | Figure out whether the number given is a square or not |- | Exponent multiplication | Multiply 2 numbers together with the same base |- | Exponent division | Divide one number by the other with the same base |} ==== Hard ==== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width: 50vw;" ! style="width=20%;" | Type of question ! style="width=70%;" | Objective ! style="width=10%;" | Time limit |- | Slope of equation | Figure out the slope of the given equation |- | Real solutions | Figure out how many real solutions a given quadratic has |} === innovative clicker game === [[File:innovative clicker game gameplay.png|400px|thumb|center]] it's a clicker game based on innovation clicker simulator. additionally you can get the [[Perfect Key]] gear from it == Settings == [[File:Computer Settings.png|400px|thumb|center]] The settings is located at the computer menu. It lets the player change the background image and the taskbar color. === Background === '''"Background pictures"''' changes the look of your computer background. * Default (artwork) * Plain black === Colors === '''"Taskbar"''' changes the color of your taskbar shown at the bottom of the computer screen. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; width: 30vw;" | Colors |- | {{Color|#000000|■|Black}} Black |- | {{Color|#363636|■|Black}} Gray |- | {{Color|#FFFFFF|■|Black}} White |- | {{Color|#FF3434|■|Black}} Red |- | {{Color|#FF8C31|■|Black}} Orange |- | {{Color|#FFFE34|■|Black}} Yellow |- | {{Color|#5AFD42|■|Black}} Green |- | {{Color|#5AF2E5|■|Black}} Cyan |- | {{Color|#3380E8|■|Black}} Blue |- | {{Color|#7E25F3|■|Black}} Purple |- | {{Color|#FF4DFF|■|Black}} Pink |- | {{Color|#4F331B|■|Black}} Brown |} [[Category:Features]]

Welcome to the {{SITENAME}} wiki! Before you start contributing, it's recommended to read this page to learn more about our expectations for our pages. ---- == General == === Page Titles === * Page titles should be 3 words maximum and only mention what the page will be about * If the topic of the page is a little bit more abstract It should be concise yet clear on what the page is about. === Page Content === * Page content should be written in British English. * Page content should be clear and concise. Use images, and tables whenever necessary. * An "introduction" section of your page should not have a title, and instead should just be placed at the top. * Text referring to the "player" should never be in the second person (eg. you), and should always be 'the player is', 'the player', 'when the player'. === Template Usage === * Templates should usually be something somewhat general or something that can be reused multiple times on the wiki (like a container or notice, or even a navbox). * If you feel like a new template should be made, contact a staff member. * Notices (such as stub) should be placed at the top of the page, and reason should always be provided. == Page Specific == === Templates === * Always use [[Currency Templates|currency templates]] when referring to an in-game currency. * More soon === Tables === * Tables should always be collapsible * Always line break after a cell is complete. e.g: Do this 
|-
| #3 
| Stronger addition 
| {{Tag|Upgrade|Green}}{{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Green}} 
| 3  
| {{Upgradecost|#3}} 
| {{Color|rgb(150, 255, 60)|+3/s|black}} {{Credits}} {{Credits|gain|symbol=no}}
|-
NOT this 
|-
| #3 || Stronger addition || {{Tag|Upgrade|Green}}{{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Green}} || 3 || {{Upgradecost|#3}} || {{Color|rgb(150, 255, 60)|+3/s|black}} {{Credits}} {{Credits|gain|symbol=no}}
|-
|-
=== Layout === Majority of pages should be in this layout, if you are not sure, ask another editor, staff, or see other pages for reference. ** Small about section (no header) ** Upgrades (table of upgrades) ** Features (if the baseplate has useable buildings eg, mystic obelisk) ** (anything else) ** Gallery ** Navigation

Prioritize using currency templates for color if feasible. * Always use [[Template:Tag|tag templates]] when referring to an in-game upgrade tags. === Tables === * Always line break after a cell is complete. e.g: Do this 
|-
| #3 
| Stronger addition 
| {{Tag|Upgrade|Green}}
{{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Green}} 
| 3  
| {{Upgradecost|#3}} 
| {{Upgrade|Green|+3/s}} {{Credits}} {{Credits|gain|symbol=no}}
|-
NOT this 
|-
| #3 || Stronger addition || {{Tag|Upgrade|Green}}
{{Tag|Upgrade|Credits-Green}} || 3 || {{Upgradecost|#3}} || {{Color...
|-
* Upgrade Tags should always '''seperated'''. Do NOT merge them. === File Uploads === * Screenshots should be taken in Low Fov (below 70). * Screenshots should be high quality. * The main subject should be clear and visible (Preferably in the center). * Uploads name should be short yet concise about what the main subject is. === Layout === Majority of pages should be in this layout, if you are not sure, ask another editor, staff, or see other pages for reference. * Small about section (no header) * Upgrades (table of upgrades) * Features (if the baseplate has useable structures e.g. Pyramid) * (anything else) * References (if applicable) * History (if applicable) * Trivia (if applicable) * Gallery * Navigation

local p = {}
local args = {} local origArgs = {} local root
local function notempty( s ) return s and s:match( '%S' ) end
local function fixChildBoxes(sval, tt) if notempty(sval) then local marker = '<span class=special_infobox_marker>' local s = sval s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(<%s*[Tt][Rr])', marker .. '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(</[Tt][Rr]%s*>)', '%1' .. marker) if s:match(marker) then s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '%s*' .. marker, '') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '([\r\n]|-[^\r\n]*[\r\n])%s*' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '%s*([\r\n]|-)', '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(</[Cc][Aa][Pp][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]%s*>%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '(<%s*[Tt][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee][^<>]*>%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^(%{|[^\r\n]*[\r\n]%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '([\r\n]%{|[^\r\n]*[\r\n]%s*)' .. marker, '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '(%s*</[Tt][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee]%s*>)', '%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, marker .. '(%s*\n|%})', '%1') end if s:match(marker) then local subcells = mw.text.split(s, marker) s = '' for k = 1, #subcells do if k == 1 then s = s .. subcells[k] .. '</' .. tt .. '></tr>' elseif k == #subcells then local rowstyle = ' style="display:none"' if notempty(subcells[k]) then rowstyle = '' end s = s .. '<tr' .. rowstyle ..'><' .. tt .. ' colspan=2>\n' .. subcells[k] elseif notempty(subcells[k]) then if (k % 2) == 0 then s = s .. subcells[k] else s = s .. '<tr><' .. tt .. ' colspan=2>\n' .. subcells[k] .. '</' .. tt .. '></tr>' end end end end -- the next two lines add a newline at the end of lists for the PHP parser -- https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template_talk:Infobox_musical_artist&oldid=849054481 -- remove when [[:phab:T191516]] is fixed or OBE s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '([\r\n][%*#;:][^\r\n]*)$', '%1\n') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^([%*#;:][^\r\n]*)$', '%1\n') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^([%*#;:])', '\n%1') s = mw.ustring.gsub(s, '^(%{%|)', '\n%1') return s else return sval end end
local function union(t1, t2) -- Returns the union of the values of two tables, as a sequence. local vals = {} for k, v in pairs(t1) do vals[v] = true end for k, v in pairs(t2) do vals[v] = true end local ret = {} for k, v in pairs(vals) do table.insert(ret, k) end return ret end
local function getArgNums(prefix) -- Returns a table containing the numbers of the arguments that exist -- for the specified prefix. For example, if the prefix was 'data', and -- 'data1', 'data2', and 'data5' exist, it would return {1, 2, 5}. local nums = {} for k, v in pairs(args) do local num = tostring(k):match('^' .. prefix .. '([1-9]%d*)$') if num then table.insert(nums, tonumber(num)) end end table.sort(nums) return nums end
local function addRow(rowArgs) -- Adds a row to the infobox, with either a header cell -- or a label/data cell combination. if rowArgs.header and rowArgs.header ~= '_BLANK_' then root :tag('tr') :addClass(rowArgs.rowclass) :cssText(rowArgs.rowstyle) :attr('id', rowArgs.rowid) :tag('th') :attr('colspan', 2) :attr('id', rowArgs.headerid) :addClass(rowArgs.class) :addClass(args.headerclass) :css('text-align', 'center') :cssText(args.headerstyle) :cssText(rowArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(rowArgs.header, 'th')) elseif rowArgs.data then if not rowArgs.data:gsub('%[%[%s*[Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee][Gg][Oo][Rr][Yy]%s*:[^]]*]]', ''):match('^%S') then rowArgs.rowstyle = 'display:none' end local row = root:tag('tr') row:addClass(rowArgs.rowclass) row:cssText(rowArgs.rowstyle) row:attr('id', rowArgs.rowid) if rowArgs.label then row :tag('th') :attr('scope', 'row') :attr('id', rowArgs.labelid) :cssText(args.labelstyle) :cssText(rowArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(rowArgs.label) :done() end
local dataCell = row:tag('td') if not rowArgs.label then dataCell :attr('colspan', 2) :css('text-align', 'center') end dataCell :attr('id', rowArgs.dataid) :addClass(rowArgs.class) :cssText(rowArgs.datastyle) :cssText(rowArgs.rowcellstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(rowArgs.data, 'td')) end end
local function renderTitle() if not args.title then return end
root :tag('caption') :addClass(args.titleclass) :cssText(args.titlestyle) :wikitext(args.title) end
local function renderAboveRow() if not args.above then return end
root :tag('tr') :tag('th') :attr('colspan', 2) :addClass(args.aboveclass) :css('text-align', 'center') :css('font-size', '125%') :css('font-weight', 'bold') :cssText(args.abovestyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(args.above,'th')) end
local function renderBelowRow() if not args.below then return end
root :tag('tr') :tag('td') :attr('colspan', '2') :addClass(args.belowclass) :css('text-align', 'center') :cssText(args.belowstyle) :wikitext(fixChildBoxes(args.below,'td')) end
local function renderSubheaders() if args.subheader then args.subheader1 = args.subheader end if args.subheaderrowclass then args.subheaderrowclass1 = args.subheaderrowclass end local subheadernums = getArgNums('subheader') for k, num in ipairs(subheadernums) do addRow({ data = args['subheader' .. tostring(num)], datastyle = args.subheaderstyle, rowcellstyle = args['subheaderstyle' .. tostring(num)], class = args.subheaderclass, rowclass = args['subheaderrowclass' .. tostring(num)] }) end end
local function renderImages() if args.image then args.image1 = args.image end if args.caption then args.caption1 = args.caption end local imagenums = getArgNums('image') for k, num in ipairs(imagenums) do local caption = args['caption' .. tostring(num)] local data = mw.html.create():wikitext(args['image' .. tostring(num)]) if caption then data :tag('div') :cssText(args.captionstyle) :wikitext(caption) end addRow({ data = tostring(data), datastyle = args.imagestyle, class = args.imageclass, rowclass = args['imagerowclass' .. tostring(num)] }) end end
local function preprocessRows() -- Gets the union of the header and data argument numbers, -- and renders them all in order using addRow. local rownums = union(getArgNums('header'), getArgNums('data')) table.sort(rownums) local lastheader for k, num in ipairs(rownums) do if args['header' .. tostring(num)] then if lastheader then args['header' .. tostring(lastheader)] = nil end lastheader = num elseif args['data' .. tostring(num)] and args['data' .. tostring(num)]:gsub('%[%[%s*[Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee][Gg][Oo][Rr][Yy]%s*:[^]]*]]', ''):match('^%S') then local data = args['data' .. tostring(num)] if data:gsub('%[%[%s*[Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee][Gg][Oo][Rr][Yy]%s*:[^]]*]]', ''):match('%S') then lastheader = nil end end end if lastheader then args['header' .. tostring(lastheader)] = nil end end
local function renderRows() -- Gets the union of the header and data argument numbers, -- and renders them all in order using addRow. local rownums = union(getArgNums('header'), getArgNums('data')) table.sort(rownums) for k, num in ipairs(rownums) do addRow({ header = args['header' .. tostring(num)], label = args['label' .. tostring(num)], data = args['data' .. tostring(num)], datastyle = args.datastyle, class = args['class' .. tostring(num)], rowclass = args['rowclass' .. tostring(num)], rowstyle = args['rowstyle' .. tostring(num)], rowcellstyle = args['rowcellstyle' .. tostring(num)], dataid = args['dataid' .. tostring(num)], labelid = args['labelid' .. tostring(num)], headerid = args['headerid' .. tostring(num)], rowid = args['rowid' .. tostring(num)] }) end end
local function _infobox() -- Specify the overall layout of the infobox, with special settings -- if the infobox is used as a 'child' inside another infobox. if args.child ~= 'yes' then root = mw.html.create('table')
root :addClass((args.subbox ~= 'yes') and 'infobox' or nil) :addClass(args.bodyclass)
if args.subbox == 'yes' then root :css('padding', '0') :css('border', 'none') :css('margin', '-3px') :css('width', 'auto') :css('min-width', '100%') :css('font-size', '100%') :css('clear', 'none') :css('float', 'none') :css('background-color', 'transparent') else root :css('width', '22em') end root :cssText(args.bodystyle)
renderTitle() renderAboveRow() else root = mw.html.create()
root :wikitext(args.title) end
renderSubheaders() renderImages() if args.autoheaders then preprocessRows() end renderRows() renderBelowRow()
return tostring(root) end
local function preprocessSingleArg(argName) -- If the argument exists and isn't blank, add it to the argument table. -- Blank arguments are treated as nil to match the behaviour of ParserFunctions. if origArgs[argName] and origArgs[argName] ~= '' then args[argName] = origArgs[argName] end end
local function preprocessArgs(prefixTable, step) -- Assign the parameters with the given prefixes to the args table, in order, in batches -- of the step size specified. This is to prevent references etc. from appearing in the -- wrong order. The prefixTable should be an array containing tables, each of which has -- two possible fields, a "prefix" string and a "depend" table. The function always parses -- parameters containing the "prefix" string, but only parses parameters in the "depend" -- table if the prefix parameter is present and non-blank. if type(prefixTable) ~= 'table' then error("Non-table value detected for the prefix table", 2) end if type(step) ~= 'number' then error("Invalid step value detected", 2) end
-- Get arguments without a number suffix, and check for bad input. for i,v in ipairs(prefixTable) do if type(v) ~= 'table' or type(v.prefix) ~= "string" or (v.depend and type(v.depend) ~= 'table') then error('Invalid input detected to preprocessArgs prefix table', 2) end preprocessSingleArg(v.prefix) -- Only parse the depend parameter if the prefix parameter is present and not blank. if args[v.prefix] and v.depend then for j, dependValue in ipairs(v.depend) do if type(dependValue) ~= 'string' then error('Invalid "depend" parameter value detected in preprocessArgs') end preprocessSingleArg(dependValue) end end end
-- Get arguments with number suffixes. local a = 1 -- Counter variable. local moreArgumentsExist = true while moreArgumentsExist == true do moreArgumentsExist = false for i = a, a + step - 1 do for j,v in ipairs(prefixTable) do local prefixArgName = v.prefix .. tostring(i) if origArgs[prefixArgName] then moreArgumentsExist = true -- Do another loop if any arguments are found, even blank ones. preprocessSingleArg(prefixArgName) end -- Process the depend table if the prefix argument is present and not blank, or -- we are processing "prefix1" and "prefix" is present and not blank, and -- if the depend table is present. if v.depend and (args[prefixArgName] or (i == 1 and args[v.prefix])) then for j,dependValue in ipairs(v.depend) do local dependArgName = dependValue .. tostring(i) preprocessSingleArg(dependArgName) end end end end a = a + step end end
local function parseDataParameters() -- Parse the data parameters in the same order that the old {{infobox}} did, so that -- references etc. will display in the expected places. Parameters that depend on -- another parameter are only processed if that parameter is present, to avoid -- phantom references appearing in article reference lists. preprocessSingleArg('autoheaders') preprocessSingleArg('child') preprocessSingleArg('bodyclass') preprocessSingleArg('subbox') preprocessSingleArg('bodystyle') preprocessSingleArg('title') preprocessSingleArg('titleclass') preprocessSingleArg('titlestyle') preprocessSingleArg('above') preprocessSingleArg('aboveclass') preprocessSingleArg('abovestyle') preprocessArgs({ {prefix = 'subheader', depend = {'subheaderstyle', 'subheaderrowclass'}} }, 10) preprocessSingleArg('subheaderstyle') preprocessSingleArg('subheaderclass') preprocessArgs({ {prefix = 'image', depend = {'caption', 'imagerowclass'}} }, 10) preprocessSingleArg('captionstyle') preprocessSingleArg('imagestyle') preprocessSingleArg('imageclass') preprocessArgs({ {prefix = 'header'}, {prefix = 'data', depend = {'label'}}, {prefix = 'rowclass'}, {prefix = 'rowstyle'}, {prefix = 'rowcellstyle'}, {prefix = 'class'}, {prefix = 'dataid'}, {prefix = 'labelid'}, {prefix = 'headerid'}, {prefix = 'rowid'} }, 50) preprocessSingleArg('headerclass') preprocessSingleArg('headerstyle') preprocessSingleArg('labelstyle') preprocessSingleArg('datastyle') preprocessSingleArg('below') preprocessSingleArg('belowclass') preprocessSingleArg('belowstyle') preprocessSingleArg('name') preprocessSingleArg('decat') end
function p.infobox(frame) -- If called via #invoke, use the args passed into the invoking template. -- Otherwise, for testing purposes, assume args are being passed directly in. if frame == mw.getCurrentFrame() then origArgs = frame:getParent().args else origArgs = frame end
parseDataParameters()
return _infobox() end
function p.infoboxTemplate(frame) -- For calling via #invoke within a template origArgs = {} for k,v in pairs(frame.args) do origArgs[k] = mw.text.trim(v) end
parseDataParameters()
return _infobox() end return p
